//workspace-trust-note: The ACP Client extension declares no untrustedWorkspaces.supported capability, so under Restricted Mode its view container never activates and the sidebar icon never appears. Users on this addon land in /workspace which is the user's own ~/Desktop — code they wrote themselves — so gating extension activation behind a trust prompt is pure friction. Disable the whole trust subsystem; the security boundary is HA login + LAN, not code-server's per-folder trust.
